_comment: Alduinak / SkyRP game server. Bring your own Skyrim Special Edition .esm files: upload them to data/ via the file manager or SFTP before starting.
name: Alduinak Server
author: ezekielj221@gmail.com
description: Multiplayer Skyrim roleplay server (SkyRP / Alduinak). Requires operator-supplied Skyrim Special Edition master files.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Alduinak server install: prepare the volume layout.
#
# The Skyrim master files are NOT downloaded here. They are part of your own
# Skyrim Special Edition installation and are not redistributable.

set -e

mkdir -p /mnt/server/data
mkdir -p /mnt/server/world
mkdir -p /mnt/server/gamemode_extensions

cat > /mnt/server/data/PUT-ESM-FILES-HERE.txt <<'EOF'
This server needs five files from your own Skyrim Special Edition install:

  Skyrim.esm
  Update.esm
  Dawnguard.esm
  HearthFires.esm
  Dragonborn.esm

Copy them from:

  <Steam>/steamapps/common/Skyrim Special Edition/Data/

into this data/ directory, using the panel file manager or SFTP.

The server refuses to start until all five are present. Delete this file
once you are done.
EOF

cat > /mnt/server/gamemode_extensions/README.txt <<'EOF'
Drop your gamemode parts here as .js files.

On every server start they are concatenated in filename order into
gamemode.js, exactly like the Server Manager's "Build gamemode only".
A part with a syntax error aborts the build and leaves the last good
gamemode.js in place.

If you would rather manage one file, delete this directory and upload
gamemode.js directly instead.
EOF

echo "Install complete. Upload your .esm files into data/ before starting."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: Shown in the launcher and on the master list.

variables.name: UI / metrics port
variables.description: TCP port for the http endpoints (static data, /metrics, /rpc). This must be a SECOND allocation assigned to this server, and must not equal the game port. Add the allocation under the Network tab first.

variables.name: Offline mode
variables.description: 1 = any profile id may connect and the master API is ignored. 0 = sessions are validated against the master API.

variables.name: Master API URL
variables.description: Backend URL used for session validation when offline mode is 0. Leave blank for a standalone server.

variables.name: Master key
variables.description: Shared secret; must match the backend SERVER_MASTER_KEY.

variables.name: Database driver
variables.description: file = flat changeForms in world/. mongodb = external MongoDB, needs the URI below.

variables.name: Database name
variables.description: Directory name for the file driver, database name for mongodb.

variables.name: Database URI
variables.description: MongoDB connection string. Only used when the driver is mongodb.

variables.name: Language
variables.description: Localisation used for game strings loaded from the data directory.
